acceptance.accepted_history_rule: Only the event exactly anchored by CURRENT.latest_event commit+path+digest is accepted history.
acceptance.duplicate_rule: Existing deterministic claim path is DUPLICATE; do not replace claim, outbox, event, or CURRENT.
acceptance.pointer_gate: Second CURRENT fetch must remain exact v65/blob 0f540c0e42e221e859f7fdf5b13dbfdd8498e833/projection digest 10ccf3e1ea7892f9537e1ca7bca28ceb6bc7ca2ac4e1d2552ab344e7739821b0 before one blob-SHA-guarded replacement; final readback must be v66.
acceptance.slack_gate: Slack post is prohibited before version advance. Post one sanitized pointer only after final CURRENT readback anchors this exact event; create a receipt, then a recovery replay scan must suppress repost when that exact receipt exists and binds this outbox and event.

canonical_transition.honest_flaw: Receipt-present replay suppression is a same-run sequential probe, not a process crash or simultaneous recovery worker test. The claim, outbox, event, CURRENT replacement, final read, Slack post, delivery receipt, replay scan, and observation are separate effects. A crash after Slack accepts the post but before the receipt is committed can still cause duplicate delivery. Git provides no cross-file transaction, database isolation or uniqueness, linearizability, exactly-once execution, force-push safety, cross-branch exclusion, orphan cleanup, or Slack atomicity.

probe.name: RECEIPT_PRESENT_SUPPRESSES_RECOVERY_REPLAY_V2
probe.result: A create-only pending Slack outbox was created and read back before CURRENT. After exact v66 final readback, the carrier must post one sanitized pointer, append an immutable delivery receipt, then perform a replay scan that suppresses a second Slack post when that exact receipt is present.

canonical_transition.rollback: Never delete the claim, outbox, event, delivery receipt, or replay observation. If v66 is later invalid, append a compensating transition from the then-current exact version; if Slack delivery is wrong or duplicated, append a correction receipt without rewriting prior evidence.
